docs.title: Departments
docs.text:
A department is a group of people at CodaCode Game Dev Studios who work on the same kind of job. Someone can belong to more than one department, and each department has leaders (who guide the work) and members (everyone else who works in it).

Departments are different from roles. A role is a person's job title, like Lead Writer. A department is the team they work in, like Writing. See the Org Chart for how they fit together, or the Directory to search everyone.

docs.title: The departments
docs.text:
• Music – Composes and directs the music and sound of CodaCode's games, from themes to sound effects.
  • Art – Creates the look of the games: characters, environments, interface art and overall art direction.
  • Ideas – Where concepts begin. Brainstorms game ideas, mechanics, worlds and features for the studio to pursue.
  • Writing – Writes the stories, dialogue and lore, and keeps the narrative consistent across projects.
  • QA – Quality Assurance. Tests the games, finds and reports bugs, and checks that everything works before release.
